portInfo.description: Porto-Vecchio is one of six Corsican commercial ports managed by CCI Corse that together attract nearly half a million cruise visitors a year (Ajaccio, Bastia, Bonifacio, L’Île-Rousse, Porto-Vecchio, Propriano). The destination page calls it a port in the town with centre access in only a few minutes’ walk. Ferry links (La Méridionale to Marseille; Corsica Ferries seasonal) share the commercial port. Published cruise planning lists small-ship overnight/day calls in autumn 2026.
